principle: A check is not a loop. Sensors observe; loops close sense -> act -> verify with the same sensor -> learn; one shared engine.

loops.name: Repair
loops.gap: Fourteen deterministic routines run inside the gateway (routine runner, VTID-05103/05141/05148/05153; learn-outcomes is owned by L3, supplier-catalog-check by L9) with a stop rule (three crashed runs in a row switch a routine off and raise routine.runner.stagnated) and repeated-breach damping (the same breach three days running is not re-sent to self-healing). Every ALERT-* workflow check except the Supabase-vs-Aurora identity drift has one gateway ops health route, and the workflows report failures to the self-healing intake. Four routines still need a claude.ai session (gh, a browser, a member sign-in, CI artifacts); they fail at the cloud environment setup script until the owner fixes it.
loops.trigger: Any owned sensor turns red (health check, routine run, alert workflow, test contract, error cluster).
loops.goal: The same sensor that fired is green again after the fix is deployed, and STAGING-VERIFY passes on that commit.
loops.act: One intake (self_healing_log) -> six-layer diagnosis -> spec -> fix through the one executor (Dev Autopilot).
loops.verifier: Re-run of the sensor that fired, plus STAGING-VERIFY. Never the agent that wrote the fix.
loops.stop: Sensor green -> close. Same failure class 3 times, or no progress after the reconciler cap -> stop and escalate.
loops.human_gate: Spec approval for any code change; rollback decisions.
loops.budget: Retry breaker: at most 5 failed attempts per finding per 24 h; reconciler re-dispatch at most every 30 min.
loops.metrics: Mean time to green per sensor; share of red sensors that reach the intake; repeat-failure rate.

loops.name: Build & Release
loops.gap: Accessibility, visual-regression and CSP gates are not built yet.
loops.trigger: An approved finding (scanner, ticket, repair spec) or a merge to main.
loops.goal: The change is merged, deployed to staging, STAGING-VERIFY passes on the deployed commit, and production passes its post-deploy check after Gate 2.
loops.act: Plan -> PR -> LLM merge review -> merge -> staging deploy -> STAGING-VERIFY -> Gate 2 -> production deploy check.
loops.verifier: CI suites, STAGING-VERIFY on the exact deployed commit, the production post-deploy check (automatic rollback on failure).
loops.stop: Verified -> complete. Retry breaker or outage gate trips -> stop and escalate.
loops.human_gate: Approval gates before execution; Gate 2 before production.
loops.budget: Retry breaker 5 failures per 24 h per finding; planner turn cap; one loop owner across staging and production.
loops.metrics: Lead time finding -> verified deploy; change failure rate; share of runs needing a human.

cases.title: Dev Autopilot scan → plan → PR → merge → verify
Visual regression on changed screens (staging, read-only)

loops.name: Learn
loops.gap: The learn-outcomes routine (VTID-05148, daily 12:00 UTC) measures repeat-failure rate per class, the share of fixes reusing a known pattern and escaped bugs that became tests; records which tests each fix PR shipped and files one write_test finding for a fix without one; and proposes (never applies) graduations on Mondays, withdrawing a proposal whose class regresses. Still recorded only: repair patterns are not auto-recorded or looked up by the executor (pattern reuse reports not measured), and prompt learnings and shadow-eval promotions have no graduation step.
loops.trigger: Every finished L1, L2 or L6 run (success or failure); every escaped bug; every shadow-eval result.
loops.goal: Each outcome leaves exactly one lesson: a new test, a repair pattern, a prompt learning, or a graduation proposal.
loops.act: Write the lesson to its existing store; propose (never apply) a graduation of a finding class to auto-approve.
loops.verifier: The lesson is checked against the next runs of the same class: repeat-failure rate must fall.
loops.stop: Lesson recorded -> done. A graduation proposal whose class regresses is withdrawn automatically.
loops.human_gate: The owner approves every graduation and every model promotion.
loops.budget: One lesson per outcome; graduation proposals at most weekly.
loops.metrics: Repeat-failure rate per class; share of fixes reusing a known pattern; escaped bugs that became tests.

loops.name: Simplify
loops.gap: New loop. Phase 1 ships its input (coverage and overlaps on the Loops screen); removals come in Phase 2.
loops.trigger: A sensor with no loop or two loops, a duplicate check, a check that never turns red, dead code, or a rule that points at a missing path.
loops.goal: The duplicate or orphan is removed or merged and sensor coverage is unchanged (no loop loses a signal).
loops.act: Propose a retire/merge -> removal PR through the executor -> re-run the coverage check.
loops.verifier: The coverage check (every sensor owned by exactly one loop) and the owning loop's own sensors stay green.
loops.stop: Overlap removed -> done. A removal that drops coverage is reverted.
loops.budget: At most one removal PR in flight at a time.
loops.metrics: Number of sensors, screens and scheduled-job lists over time (should fall); orphan count (should be 0).

loops.name: Guard
loops.gap: LLM spend is compared with the budgets daily (llm-spend-budget, alert only) and any LLM call that lands on Google is an incident (llm-fallback-watch), both VTID-05141; agents_registry.enabled is enforced as the per-agent kill switch. Blocking calls over budget, the GCP carve-out window watcher and the consent audit do not exist yet.
loops.trigger: A cost, model-fallback, secret, test-account, consent or ledger-integrity signal.
loops.goal: Every such signal reaches the owner (or DPO) with evidence within one check interval.
loops.act: Escalate only. This loop never changes code, data or configuration by itself.
loops.verifier: The escalation is acknowledged; the underlying check returns to green.
loops.stop: Acknowledged and green -> close. Unacknowledged -> re-escalate every interval.
loops.human_gate: Owner or DPO decides every action.
loops.metrics: Time to acknowledge; number of silent fallbacks (should be 0); spend per stage versus budget.

loops.name: Support
loops.gap: Answer acceptance does not feed the knowledge base yet.
loops.trigger: A member files a ticket (app, voice, or the conversation with Devon).
loops.goal: The ticket is closed with a verified fix or an accepted answer, and the reporter is notified.
loops.act: Auto-triage -> Devon drafts a spec / Sage drafts an answer -> supervisor review -> executor -> completion reconciler -> reporter notified.
loops.verifier: Supervisor review of drafts; the fix passes L2; the support regression suite stays green.
loops.stop: Closed and notified -> done. Placeholder specs are blocked.
loops.human_gate: A human activates dispatch to the executor.
loops.budget: As L2 for the fix; one draft per ticket revision.
loops.metrics: Time to close; reopen rate; answer acceptance rate.

loops.name: Voice quality
loops.gap: Opener, slow-session and fallback gates run; voice-lab-triage compares 24 h of voice_session_facts outcomes and failure classes with the prior 7 days (VTID-05141). Tool success, misroutes, locale errors and provider cost per language are not measured as a loop.
loops.goal: Per-language opener success, tool success and misroute rate meet their targets.
loops.act: Tuning PR (tool description, navigation phrasing, prompt intent) -> shadow -> enforce.
loops.verifier: The same session metrics over the next window, in shadow before enforce.
loops.stop: Target met -> hold. A tuning that regresses in shadow is dropped.
loops.budget: One tuning change per metric in shadow at a time.
loops.metrics: Opener success, tool success, misroute rate, wrong-locale sessions, cost per minute per language.

loops.name: Content & language
loops.gap: The LLM translation audit runs only by hand; the du-form and RTL checks are not built.
loops.trigger: A new or changed string, a new feature entry, or new curated content.
loops.goal: All 11 locales are complete, pass the register and RTL checks, and new finished features get one What's New card.
loops.act: Propagate German source to every locale -> audit -> apply suggestions with confidence >= 0.80 -> What's New once the build is live.
loops.verifier: Locale completeness check, the LLM audit (a second model), and the shared claim verifier for curated content.
loops.human_gate: A human merges translation and What's New PRs.
loops.budget: One audit per locale per change.
loops.metrics: Locale coverage; audit score per locale; formal-register findings (should be 0).

loops.name: Supplier catalog
loops.gap: Wave 1 (VTID-05153): the supplier-catalog-check routine (daily 13:00 UTC, at most 20 supplement rows per run, no LLM) normalizes rows losslessly, checks required fields and money, finds duplicates within a supplier, probes images (SSRF-guarded HEAD, outage guard), pre-screens disease claims (a hit only routes to human review), stores one result per row and returns a row to the supplier after the same failure 3 times (checklist catalogue_fixes, MCP next_action); it never publishes. Partner verification and marketplace sync also run. Not yet: verified claims (shared claim verifier, Phase 6), certificate expiry (needs the evidence tables), stock/reorder drafts (S10), sync drift (S07), WooCommerce feed import.
loops.trigger: A supplier signs up or submits a feed; a source feed changes; stock crosses its threshold.
loops.goal: 80% of supplier product rows are normalized, validated and ready for approval without manual entry; live listings match their source.
loops.act: Normalize with deterministic validators first, LLM only for extraction and exceptions -> claim, media, certificate and duplicate checks -> draft -> approval -> publish -> keep in sync.
loops.verifier: Schema validators, the shared claim verifier, image and certificate checks, sync drift check.
loops.stop: All rows valid and approved -> publish. The same validation error 3 times -> back to the supplier.
loops.human_gate: Human review and publish; purchase orders are drafted only, never paid by the loop.
loops.budget: Narrow first: one category, at most 20 SKUs per run.
loops.metrics: Rows auto-normalized; validation failure rate; time to listing; human edits per listing.

loops.name: Listing & creator commerce
loops.trigger: A new or low-converting listing; a creator uploads a video.
loops.goal: The listing passes schema, media and completeness checks; conversion improves against a control.
loops.act: Audit -> product match and copy/caption variants under the claim verifier -> creator or supplier approves -> measure.
loops.verifier: Schema and media checks, the shared claim verifier, CTR/CVR against a control.
loops.stop: Checks pass and the variant beats control -> keep; otherwise revert to control.
loops.human_gate: The creator or supplier approves every published change.

loops.name: Trust
loops.trigger: A new review or a member report.
loops.goal: Every report is classified within its SLA and a human decides; suspicious reviews are held before they show.
loops.act: Classify (fraud, abuse, test account) -> hold -> human decision -> feed the decision back to the classifier.
loops.verifier: Moderator decisions measured against the classifier.
loops.metrics: Time to decision; classifier precision against moderator decisions.

loops.name: Engagement
loops.gap: The morning-brief pacer and lifecycle worker run; mute/unsubscribe rates do not yet adjust cadence.
loops.trigger: Every notification, nudge or tour step sent.
loops.goal: Open and activation rates rise without a rise in mute or unsubscribe rates.
loops.act: Propose a cadence or throttle change within fixed bounds; apply it once a human approves.
loops.verifier: Open, mute and unsubscribe rates over the next window.
loops.stop: A cadence change that raises mutes is reverted.
loops.human_gate: A human approves every cadence change. Automatic changes inside fixed bounds wait for the per-loop kill switch and budget (roadmap Phase 3).
loops.budget: Cadence can only move within the configured minimum and maximum.
loops.metrics: Open rate; activation rate; mute and unsubscribe rate.

loops.name: Community matching
loops.gap: Community autopilot runs in shadow; acceptance and attendance do not feed the weights yet.
loops.trigger: Daily recompute; a match, event or recommendation is shown.
loops.act: Recompute matches and recommendations -> propose -> learn from acceptance.
loops.verifier: Acceptance and attendance over the next window.
loops.stop: A weight change that lowers acceptance is reverted.
loops.human_gate: Supervisor or tenant admin approves proposals.
loops.metrics: Match acceptance; event attendance; recommendation acceptance.

loops.name: Health coaching
loops.gap: Guided journey and the daily index recompute run; check-in plans, prepared carts and adherence tracking do not.
loops.trigger: A member check-in or newly consented data.
loops.goal: The member gets a non-diagnostic plan, accepts or rejects each action, and the outcome is recorded for the next cycle.
loops.act: Summarize consented data -> plan -> prepare a cart or booking (never execute) -> member confirms -> track adherence -> adjust.
loops.verifier: The shared claim verifier (no diagnosis or treatment claims) and red-flag rules (urgent-care escalation) on every reply.
loops.stop: Plan delivered and the member decided -> record. A red flag -> stop and escalate to urgent-care guidance.
loops.human_gate: The member confirms every action; a professional reviews lab results.
loops.budget: No autonomous purchase or booking, ever.
loops.metrics: Plan acceptance; adherence; red-flag escalations handled correctly on the eval set.
